title: Hungry Ben
text:
Mom: Hello, Ben! Ben: Hi, Mom. Mom: Are you hungry? Ben: Yes, I am.

Mom: Here is an apple. Ben: Thank you! Mom: You are welcome. Ben: Good!

questions.text: What does Mom give Ben in the second paragraph?
How does Ben probably feel about the apple?
Who is probably talking in this passage?
options: A bus driver and a shop worker

vocabulary.definition: a word you say when you meet someone
a round fruit that is red, green or yellow
a polite answer when someone says thank you

paragraph_translations: Мама: Привіт, Бен! Бен: Привіт, мамо. Мама: Ти голодний? Бен: Так, я голодний.
Мама: Ось яблуко. Бен: Дякую! Мама: Будь ласка. Бен: Добре!
